metadata.title: Uncovering Key Factors of Student Performance in Math: An Explainable Deep Learning Approach Using TIMSS 2019 Data

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study constructs a binary target from TIMSS plausible values but does not document how the five plausible values were combined, indicating improper handling.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study mentions using TIMSS data but does not report applying any sampling weights, suggesting an unweighted analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not provide information on using multilevel modeling or any methods that account for school clustering, indicating a focus on student-level models.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation strategies and appears to rely solely on internal validation methods.
